cd /app/tmp/fz && python3 - <<'EOF'
src=open('validate.py').read()
i=src.index("def val_export(req, out):")
jj = src[:i].index("def val_export")  # first occurrence index
# find end: next top-level def or EOF
rest=src[i:]
# find next "^def " at column 0
import re
m=re.search(r"^def ", rest[1:], re.M)
newfn = '''def val_export(req, out):
    mod=out["module"]
    assert mod.rstrip().startswith("---- MODULE ModelData ----")
    assert mod.rstrip().endswith("====")
    lines=[l for l in mod.split("\\n") if l.strip()]
    body=lines[1:-1]
    assert body[0]=="EXTENDS Integers, Sequences, FiniteSets"
    names_def=[]; defs=[]
    for l in body[1:]:
        kk,vv=l.split("==",1)
        names_def.append(kk.strip()); defs.append(vv.strip())
    expect=["Nodes","Initial","Edges","ActionNames","WFIds","SFIds","SafeNodes","DoneNodes"]
    assert names_def==expect, names_def
    txt=defs[0].strip(); assert txt=="0..%d"%(len(req["states"])-1)
    assert defs[1].strip()==str(req["start"])
    def parse_set(s):
        s=s.strip(); assert s.startswith("{") and s.endswith("}"), s
        inner=s[1:-1].strip(); out=set()
        if not inner: return out
        parts=[p.strip() for p in inner.split(",")]
        assert all(p for p in parts) and all(p.lstrip("-").isdigit() for p in parts), parts
        return set(int(p) for p in parts)
    edges=[tuple(e) for e in req["edges"]]
    txt=defs[2].strip(); assert txt.startswith("{") and txt.endswith("}"), txt
    inner=txt[1:-1].strip(); trip=[]
    if inner:
        rest=inner
        while rest:
            m2=re.match(r"<<\\s*(-?\\d+)\\s*,\\s*(-?\\d+)\\s*,\\s*(-?\\d+)\\s*>>\\s*,?\\s*", rest)
            assert m2, rest[:60]
            trip.append(tuple(int(x) for x in m2.groups()))
            rest=rest[m2.end():].strip()
    txt=defs[3].strip(); assert txt.startswith("<<") and txt.endswith(">>"), txt
    names=re.findall(r'"([^"]*)"', txt) if txt[2:-2].strip() else []
    allnames=set()
    for e in edges: allnames.add(e[1])
    for f in req["fairness"]: allnames.add(f["action"])
    assert set(names)==allnames, (names,allnames)
    assert names==sorted(allnames)
    aidx={a:i+1 for i,a in enumerate(names)}
    assert len(trip)==len(edges)
    for t,(s,lab,tg) in zip(trip, edges):
        assert (t[0],t[2])==(s,tg) and t[1]==aidx[lab], (t,(s,lab,tg))
    wf=parse_set(defs[4]); sf=parse_set(defs[5])
    expwf={aidx[f["action"]] for f in req["fairness"] if f["mode"]=="weak"}
    expsf={aidx[f["action"]] for f in req["fairness"] if f["mode"]=="strong"}
    assert wf==expwf, (wf,expwf); assert sf==expsf, (sf,expsf)
    safe=parse_set(defs[6]); done=parse_set(defs[7])
    P=len(req["inputs"]); R=len(req["inputs"][0]) if P else 0; D=len(req["inputs"][0][0]) if R else 0
    exp=[]
    for q in range(R):
        s=[0]*D
        for r in range(P):
            v=req["inputs"][r][q]
            for j in range(D): s[j]+=v[j]
        exp.append(s)
    for i,st in enumerate(req["states"]):
        ok=True
        for r in range(P):
            for qq,v in enumerate(st["delivered"][r]):
                if v!=exp[qq]: ok=False
        for sl in st["slots"]:
            tot=[0]*D
            for r in sl["ranks"]:
                v=req["inputs"][r][sl["seq"]]
                for j in range(D): tot[j]+=v[j]
            if sl["sum"]!=tot: ok=False
        assert ok==(i in safe), ("safenode",i)
        isdone=all(len(st["delivered"][r])==R for r in range(P))
        assert isdone==(i in done), ("donenode",i)
    cfg=out["config"]
    toks=cfg.split()
    assert toks==["SPECIFICATION","Spec","INVARIANT","Safety","PROPERTY","Termination","CHECK_DEADLOCK","FALSE"], toks
    return None
'''
src = src[:src.index("def val_export(req, out):")] + newfn
open('validate.py','w').write(src)
EOF
